title: AL-QASIDA: Analyzing LLM Quality and Accuracy Systematically in Dialectal Arabic

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM proficiency and reluctance in generating Dialectal Arabic (DA) versus Modern Standard Arabic (MSA) across four dimensions: fidelity (using dialect classification models like NADI and ALDi), understanding (via DA-to-English machine translation metrics like SpBLEU), quality (via English-to-DA translation and fluency), and diglossia (translating between MSA and DA), supplemented by human evaluations.
